common_parameters.latent_injection_method: Latent vector `z` (128-dim) is expanded and concatenated with the input sequence embeddings (128-dim) at EVERY timestep during decoding to form a 256-dim GRU input, forcing autoregressive dependence on the prior.
common_parameters.random_seeds_used: Not explicitly set in the training scripts (default system entropy).

training_parameters.kl_annealing_schedule: Linear warmup over 25 epochs: `beta = min(1.0, epoch / 25)`

conv_blocks: Dilated Conv1d(128 -> 256, kernel=3, dilation=1) -> LayerNorm -> GELU + Residual
Dilated Conv1d(256 -> 256, kernel=3, dilation=2) -> LayerNorm -> GELU + Residual
Dilated Conv1d(256 -> 256, kernel=3, dilation=4) -> LayerNorm -> GELU + Residual
Dilated Conv1d(256 -> 256, kernel=3, dilation=8) -> LayerNorm -> GELU + Residual
encoder_architecture.pooling_strategy: Dual pooling (AdaptiveMaxPool1d + AdaptiveAvgPool1d), concatenated to 512 dimensions

training_parameters.kl_annealing_schedule: Linear warmup over 25 epochs: `beta = min(1.0, epoch / 25)`

message_passing_layers: GINEConv(MLP: Linear(128, 128) -> ReLU -> Linear(128, 128)) -> BatchNorm1d -> ReLU + Residual
GINEConv(MLP: Linear(128, 128) -> ReLU -> Linear(128, 128)) -> BatchNorm1d -> ReLU + Residual
encoder_architecture.pooling_strategy: Dual graph pooling (global_max_pool + global_mean_pool), concatenated to 256 dimensions -> F.normalize(dim=-1)

optimizer.parameter_scope: Only updates fusion network, balance gates, and decoder. Base encoders frozen.

training_parameters.kl_annealing_schedule: Extended linear warmup over 40 epochs: `beta = min(1.0, epoch / 40)`. Beta reaches 0.5 at epoch 20.
training_parameters.balance_loss_regularization: Magnitude equalizer tracking pre-normalization modalities with weight 0.01: `loss = loss + 0.01 * MSE(norm(h_seq), norm(h_graph))`

gated_fusion_mechanism.gate_layer: Linear(128, 128) -> Sigmoid -> Chunked to g_seq(64), g_graph(64)
gated_fusion_mechanism.normalization: Both gated vectors individually L2-normalized via F.normalize(dim=-1)

encoder_architecture.fusion_mlp: Concatenated normalized vectors (128) -> Sequential(Linear(128, 128), ReLU, Linear(128, 128))
